entry.name: Talos electrician wire-nut sample
entry.title: Free sample: electrician joining a ceiling light's wires with wire nuts: head-mounted stereo egocentric video, 12-IMU tactile glove, force in newtons and 3D hand pose
entry.venue: Hugging Face dataset (free sample of a commercial dataset)
entry.summary: One 62 s episode of a residential electrician joining a ceiling fixture's wires with wire nuts, recorded with a right-hand Talos glove (10 force-sensing-resistor pads on the fingertips and palm at 200 Hz, 12 BMI160 IMUs giving a 21-joint MANO-order hand pose) and a head-mounted Luxonis OAK-D Pro W (2016x1520 colour plus a 640x400 global-shutter stereo pair).
entry.hand: Talos glove, right hand, worn under a work glove

sensor.note: 10 force-sensing-resistor pads: F0 thumb pad, F1-F4 index to little fingertips, P0 thenar, P1 hypothenar, P2 distal palm, P3 central palm, P4 index-base palm. Per pad: conductance in microsiemens (observation.hand.right.pads), raw 12-bit ADC in the talos/ sidecar, and estimated newtons from each pad's pre-sewing load-cell bench curve (observation.hand.right.pad_force). 200 Hz raw, 30 Hz in the LeRobot frames. F1 (index tip) gave no signal in this recording and P4 has no bench curve.
sensor.range: bench-measured ranges 0.32-23 N (F0) to 0.43-39 N (P0) per the card

scale.text: Sample: 1 episode, 62 s, 1,860 frames per camera at 30 fps (step 6 of a 25-step, 26-minute job); the full 25-episode recording is sold separately

entry.access: Hugging Face talosdataworks/electrician-wire-nuts-tactile-glove-hand-pose-sample, ungated, 102.6 MB (LeRobot v2.1 parquet and AV1 videos plus a talos/ folder of raw sensor streams); the full 26-minute job is offered through Datarade or talosdataworks.com.

gate.note: The one-episode sample is public; the card says the full 25-step dataset is available from Talos Dataworks on Datarade or through talosdataworks.com. No price is stated on the card.

caveats: Single 62 s episode from one electrician at one home site; the card states CC BY-NC 4.0 for this sample only and no licence for the full dataset.

Force in newtons is an estimate from bench curves measured before the pads were sewn into the glove; the card says hysteresis, repeatability and drift missed their targets (10%, 5%, 8% in about 5 min) for most pads and advises relying on contact timing and relative changes. Nothing was checked against a reference instrument during the job.

The index-tip pad (F1) stays at its untouched level for the whole episode, so index-tip contact is not captured; the index-base palm pad (P4) has no bench run. Peak forces in this episode are 6.0 N or less on every pad.

Hand pose is computed from the 12 glove IMUs (no magnetometer) on a template skeleton: 21 joints in MANO order in the hand frame, not fitted MANO parameters; the hand's position and heading relative to the camera are not given, and the card expects absolute joint-angle offsets of up to about 10 degrees.
The glove runs on its own clock; each episode's hand_right.json gives the fitted offset and drift to the camera clock (5.2 ms uncertainty, 9.1 ms RMS residual per the card).
A second Talos Dataworks sample on Hugging Face (electrician-wiring-egocentric-stereo-sample) has no glove and is not in the catalog.

cameras.model: Luxonis OAK-D Pro W (global-shutter stereo pair)

tracking.system: Talos glove, 12 Bosch BMI160 IMUs (hand back and finger segments)
tracking.note: 21-joint 3D hand pose in MANO joint order (metres, hand frame) and 21 joint angles derived from the IMUs; distal joints estimated
about 400 Hz raw, 30 Hz in the LeRobot frames

other: raw glove IMU and pad streams at 200 Hz and camera IMU in a talos/ sidecar folder

sources: https://huggingface.co/datasets/talosdataworks/electrician-wire-nuts-tactile-glove-hand-pose-sample (README.md, Hugging Face API metadata and top-level listing)
unconfirmed: hours = 62 s / 3600, from the card's stated duration.
No depth stream is released; the stereo pair is given as two grey videos.
'language' from the card: each episode carries a plain-language step label in its task string; the string itself was not read (tasks.jsonl not opened).
The glove maker is taken to be Talos Dataworks because the card calls it 'the Talos glove'; no separate maker page was read.
